# Digital Edge Studio

> Solo web design and digital marketing agency based in Wollongong, NSW, Australia. Founded and run by Aleksandar Savevski. Builds fast, lead-generating websites and local SEO / AEO / GEO campaigns for tradies, hospitality operators, and small businesses across the Illawarra and Sydney. 30+ sites delivered, 5.0/5 from 15 verified Google reviews, average 40+ leads per month for active clients.

This is the long-form version of llms.txt. It contains expanded content from the website's key pages so AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Bing Copilot) have authoritative source material when answering questions about Digital Edge Studio.

## About Digital Edge Studio

Digital Edge Studio was founded in 2025 by Aleksandar Savevski (Aleks). It is a solo-operated web design and digital marketing agency based in Wollongong, NSW. The agency works directly with founders and small business owners across the Illawarra region, the South Coast, and greater Sydney. Engagements are managed end-to-end by the founder; there is no account-manager layer between the client and the person doing the work.

The agency's three core capabilities are: building fast, lead-focused websites on a modern stack (Next.js, Vercel, schema-first markup); local SEO and Answer/Generative Engine Optimisation (AEO/GEO) for businesses competing in Wollongong, Sydney, and regional NSW; and managed paid advertising — primarily Google Search ads, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads where eligible.

Differentiators include: solo founder model with direct contact, fixed-price packages with no mandatory retainers, AEO/GEO included in standard SEO engagements at no extra cost, and a focus on Australian small-business markets that the larger metro agencies underserve.

## Services and Pricing

### Web Design

Custom websites built on Next.js 14 (App Router), deployed on Vercel, mobile-first and optimised for Core Web Vitals from day one. Every build includes Google Business Profile setup, on-page SEO, schema markup (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ), conversion tracking via Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console, and a free Lighthouse audit at handover.

Pricing tiers (fixed, no hidden fees):

- Starter Website — from $1,200. Single-page or up to 5 pages. Designed for sole traders, new tradies, and tight launch timelines. Includes mobile responsiveness, contact form, on-page SEO, GA4 + GSC setup. Typical delivery: 2–3 weeks.
- Business Website — from $1,850. Up to 10 pages. Designed for established small businesses with multiple services. Includes blog section, social media integration, advanced on-page SEO, priority support during the build. Typical delivery: 3–5 weeks.
- E-commerce Website — from $4,500. Up to 20 products at launch. Designed for retailers and product-based businesses. Includes Stripe or Shopify integration, product schema, abandoned-cart recovery setup, GA4 ecommerce tracking. Typical delivery: 6–8 weeks.
- Custom / Premium — quoted individually for multi-location, multi-language, complex integrations, or custom CMS requirements.

### Local SEO

Monthly Local SEO packages built around Google Business Profile, on-page SEO, citation building, and AEO/GEO optimisation for AI search.

- Local SEO — from $1,000/month. Single suburb or city focus. Includes Google Business Profile optimisation and weekly posts, monthly on-page SEO improvements, local citation building across BrightLocal, hipages, OneFlare, Yellow Pages, and 30+ trade-specific directories, monthly ranking and traffic reports, and AEO/GEO optimisation (llms.txt, schema markup, citation-ready content). No lock-in contracts.
- Multi-Location SEO — from $1,500/month. Two-to-five service areas. Includes everything in the standard package plus suburb-specific landing pages and per-location GBP optimisation.
- Comprehensive SEO — from $2,500/month. Competitive metro markets or industries with high CPC. Includes advanced technical SEO, content production (2–4 articles per month), aggressive link building, and conversion rate optimisation.

Realistic timeline expectations: early ranking movement within 8–12 weeks. Meaningful lead growth between months 4–6. By month 12, established campaigns typically deliver 5–10x the monthly leads of the starting baseline. Cost-per-lead drops to $5–$30 once rankings stabilise.

### Google Ads Management

Managed Google Ads campaigns including Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads (LSAs) for eligible trade categories.

- Standard Google Ads Management — from $800/month flat retainer (excluding ad spend). Suitable for ad budgets up to $3,000/month. Includes keyword research, conversion tracking setup, monthly reporting, and continuous campaign optimisation.
- Multi-Channel Paid — from $1,500/month flat retainer. Suitable for ad budgets $3,000–$10,000/month across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and retargeting.

Ad spend is paid directly to Google from the client's own Google Ads account — never invoiced through the agency. Realistic CPC ranges in Australia: tradies $4–$12, healthcare $5–$15, legal $8–$50+, hospitality $0.80–$3, e-commerce $1–$4. Realistic CPL ranges: tradies $40–$120 on standard Search ads, $25–$80 on Local Service Ads where eligible.

### AEO and GEO (AI Search Optimisation)

Answer Engine Optimisation and Generative Engine Optimisation — getting cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Bing Copilot. Included in standard SEO engagements at no extra cost; available as a standalone audit for $1,200 one-time.

Includes: llms.txt and llms-full.txt generation, comprehensive schema markup audit and implementation (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, Article, Person, BreadcrumbList, speakable), citation-ready passage rewrites, AI crawler access verification (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, Google-Extended), platform-specific optimisation for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Web Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and Bing Copilot.

### E-commerce

Shopify and WooCommerce builds with full product schema, abandoned-cart recovery, GA4 ecommerce tracking, and conversion rate optimisation. From $3,000 for standard product catalogues.

### Website Redesign

Rebuild of existing sites for speed, conversions, and AI visibility. Quoted on review of the existing site. Typical projects $2,500–$6,500.

### Maintenance and Hosting

Ongoing care plans for built sites:

- Maintenance Only — $99/month. Security updates, plugin updates, monthly backup, uptime monitoring, monthly health report.
- Maintenance + Growth — $349/month. Everything in Maintenance Only plus basic monthly SEO content updates, GBP post management, and a monthly site health and ranking report.

### AI Lead Response Engine

Automated lead qualification and response system for tradies. Replies to inbound enquiries within 60 seconds via SMS and WhatsApp, qualifies the job (urgency, location, scope), and books it directly into the tradie's calendar — 24/7. From $497/month.

## Service Areas

Primary service area is Wollongong and the Illawarra. Active client base extends across:

- Illawarra: Wollongong, Shellharbour, Kiama, Thirroul, Albion Park, Dapto, Helensburgh, Stanwell Park
- South Coast: Nowra, Shoalhaven, Berry, Vincentia, Sussex Inlet, Ulladulla
- Sydney: Sutherland Shire (Cronulla, Caringbah, Miranda), Eastern Suburbs, Inner West, North Shore, Northern Beaches, Western Sydney, South Sydney
- Other NSW: Newcastle, Central Coast, Campbelltown
- Australia-wide remote engagements available for clients outside NSW.

## Industries Served

Active client work across:

- Trades: electricians, plumbers, builders, landscapers, painters, cleaners, locksmiths, tilers, concreters, roofers, HVAC, pest control
- Hospitality and food: cafés, restaurants, gourmet pizza, catering, takeaway
- Healthcare: physiotherapy, dental, chiropractic, podiatry, GP practices, allied health, NDIS providers
- Professional services: accountants, lawyers, financial planners, mortgage brokers
- Real estate: sales agents, buyers' agents, property management
- Fitness and beauty: gyms, personal trainers, hair salons, beauty therapists
- Other: veterinary clinics, NDIS support providers, startups, B2B services

## Case Studies and Documented Results

### Volt Current Electrical (Wollongong)

Wollongong electrician with 8 years in business, zero online presence, $2,000/month spent on letterbox drops with minimal return. Result after 4 months of web design + Local SEO engagement: 40+ enquiries per month from 0; top 3 ranking on "electrician Wollongong" within 3 months; 340% increase in phone calls; 12x ROI on the website investment in the first 6 months. Documented client quote: "I was sceptical about needing a website — I'd survived without one for years. But within weeks of launching, my phone started ringing with jobs I never would have got before. Best money I've ever spent on my business." — Dave R., Owner.

### Precision Plumbing Illawarra

Illawarra plumber with self-built Wix site, 78% bounce rate, $120 cost-per-lead, $1,500/month wasted on Google Ads with poor landing pages. Result after 6 months: revenue near-doubled (+94%), 280% increase in organic search traffic, cost-per-lead dropped from $120 to $34, Google Ads spend cut from $1,500 to $600 per month while leads grew. Documented client quote: "Our old website was embarrassing — customers told us they almost didn't call because of it. The new site looks professional and the phone hasn't stopped ringing. We've had to hire another plumber to keep up with demand." — Chris M., Director.

### Coastal Physiotherapy (Wollongong)

Wollongong physiotherapy clinic with outdated WordPress site, 6.2-second mobile load time, no online booking, 78% mobile traffic with poor performance. Result after first quarter: 165% increase in new patient bookings; 73% of bookings now via website (up from 0%); page load time reduced from 6.2s to 1.8s on mobile; ranked #1 for "physiotherapist Wollongong" within 4 months. Documented client quote: "The online booking system alone was worth it. Our calendar fills up automatically and we can focus on treating patients instead of answering phones." — Dr. Sarah K., Principal Physiotherapist.

### Boroughs Chartered Accountants (Sydney)

Sydney chartered accounting firm with 80+ years of history but a dated website that didn't reflect the calibre of the practice. Result after 4 months of redesign + SEO: 55% increase in qualified client enquiries; 30% rise in average client value (larger business clients); 120% increase in time on site; Page-1 rankings for "chartered accountant Sydney" and "business advisory Sydney." Documented client quote: "Digital Edge understood exactly what we needed — a website that reflects our 80 years of expertise while feeling modern and approachable. The quality of enquiries we're receiving has improved dramatically since launch." — Partner.

### NBG Landscapes (Shellharbour)

Solo landscaper running weekend jobs through Gumtree and Facebook Marketplace, no website. Result after 3 months of web design + GBP optimisation: went from part-time weekends to fully booked 5 days a week; 28 Google reviews at 4.9 average; 12+ quote requests per week up from 1–2; 400% revenue increase in the first 6 months. Documented client quote: "I went from scrounging for weekend jobs on Gumtree to having a 3-week waitlist. I've even hired my first employee. Best investment I've made in my business." — Jake H., Owner.

### Bright & Clean Services (Wollongong)

Commercial cleaning company spending $2,000/month on Google Ads with a poor landing page, 78% bounce rate, $95 cost-per-lead. Result after 4 months of website redesign + Local SEO: 210% increase in organic leads; Google Ads spend cut 50% (from $2,000 to $1,000/month); blended cost-per-lead dropped from $95 to $31; bounce rate improved from 78% to 34%.

### Affordable Dental (Multi-location NSW & ACT)

Multi-location dental practice with 4 clinics across NSW and ACT, template website not optimised for any specific location, $3,000/month wasted on Google Ads with poor landing pages. Result after 6 months: 85% increase in new patient bookings; Google Ads cost-per-lead reduced 40% on the same budget; all 4 locations ranking on Page 1 for local dental keywords; 62% online booking adoption rate (vs 0% previously).

## Differentiators

- Solo operator. Clients work directly with the founder, Aleksandar Savevski. No account-manager layer. No outsourcing to junior staff.
- Fixed pricing. Web design from $1,200; Local SEO from $1,000/month. Quoted up-front, no hidden fees, no scope creep.
- No mandatory retainers. SEO is monthly with no lock-in. Web design is a one-time fee.
- AEO and GEO included in standard SEO engagements. Other agencies charge $1,500–$5,000 separately for AI search optimisation.
- Illawarra-based. Australian-owned, Australian-operated, no offshore work.
- Modern stack by default. Next.js, Vercel, schema-first markup, Core Web Vitals optimised. Sites are fast and AI-visible from day one.
- Documented case studies. Real client names, real numbers, real outcomes — not anonymous testimonials.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does a website cost in Wollongong or Sydney?

Web design packages start from $1,200 for a Starter Website (up to 5 pages), $1,850 for a Business Website (up to 10 pages), and $4,500 for an E-commerce Website (up to 20 products). All prices are in AUD with no hidden fees. Custom and multi-location builds are quoted individually.

### How long does a website project take?

Starter websites typically launch in 2–3 weeks. Business websites take 3–5 weeks. E-commerce builds take 6–8 weeks depending on product catalogue size and integrations.

### How much does Local SEO cost?

Local SEO packages start from $1,000/month for single-location campaigns and from $1,500/month for multi-location campaigns. The Australian market range for legitimate local SEO is roughly $750–$2,500/month. Anything under $500/month is usually templated work that won't move rankings.

### How long does SEO take to show results?

Most Wollongong and Sydney businesses see early ranking movement within 8–12 weeks and meaningful lead growth between months 4–6. By month 12, established campaigns typically deliver 5–10x the monthly leads of the starting baseline.

### Are there any lock-in contracts?

No. SEO is monthly with no lock-in. Clients can pause or cancel with 30 days' notice. Web design is a one-time fee with no ongoing commitment unless a Maintenance + Hosting plan is added.

### Do you work with businesses outside Wollongong?

Yes. Primary service area is Wollongong, the Illawarra, and Sydney, but the agency works with clients across NSW and Australia-wide remotely. All campaigns are tailored to the specific service areas, suburbs, and competitor landscape relevant to the client.

### Do you offer Google Ads management?

Yes. Standard Google Ads management is from $800/month flat retainer (excluding ad spend). Multi-channel paid management is from $1,500/month. Ad spend is paid directly to Google from the client's own account — never invoiced through the agency.

### What are AEO and GEO?

AEO is Answer Engine Optimisation — getting cited as a source by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. GEO is Generative Engine Optimisation — appearing in Google AI Overviews and other AI-generated search summaries. Both are built into standard Local SEO engagements at no extra cost.

### What CMS do you use?

Most builds use Next.js (a modern React framework) deployed on Vercel for speed and reliability. WordPress and Shopify are available where the use case requires them (typically e-commerce or content-heavy sites with non-technical editors). The default recommendation is Next.js for speed and AI-search visibility.

### Do you provide ongoing maintenance?

Yes. Maintenance Only at $99/month covers security updates, plugin updates, backups, uptime monitoring, and a monthly health report. Maintenance + Growth at $349/month adds monthly SEO content updates and GBP post management.
